input.quote: 12.4 During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.
input.rationale: The duplicate-numbered § 12.4 (p0046) binds Customer not to develop, market, sell or acquire any competing product or service, for the term plus twenty-four months, in any territory. That is walk-away territory under this rule: the scope is undefined ("any product or service that competes with Vendor"), it is not limited to a named product, it extends post-term beyond 12 months, and it has no carve-out for internal development or acquisitions — so it fails every fallback element. It also directly contradicts § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no non-compete commitment. We therefore take the preferred position and convert the prohibition into an express permission with the shortest possible edit, leaving the rest of the sentence and the section numbering intact. The separate no-hire covenant in the other § 12.4 (p0045) is left for the non-solicitation rule.

mappings.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.

proposal.summary: Convert § 12.4's non-compete on Customer into an express permission, removing any non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a restriction on the products or services we may develop, buy or sell, so we have turned this duplicate § 12.4 into an express permission, consistent with § 12.3's acknowledgement that we have given no non-compete commitment. If you need protection we could discuss a restriction limited to one named competing product, during the term only and no longer than 12 months, with carve-outs for our internal development and acquisitions.

ops.oldText: During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.
ops.newText: Customer may develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.
